comparison: Pixel-identical to the original 2017 museum export at Wikimedia. The museum’s current independent 3490 by 2884 scan of the same print retains a white border and visibly matches the Qualla photograph’s dome, four small bays, damaged minarets, scaffolding and foreground figures.
